digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool execution and convergence boundary
propositions: When tool_step_limit cutoff is reached after a tool call, pydantic-ai omits toolConfig from the request while the message history contains toolUse blocks, causing Bedrock Converse and Anthropic to reject with ValidationException 400.
The current filtering mechanism that hides tools mid-run violates provider protocol constraints that mandate toolConfig must be present whenever toolUse or toolResult blocks exist in history.
Bounded recovery fallback (completion_recovery.py with _EVIDENCE_TOOL_STEPS=16) dies with the same 400 error if an evidence run reaches step 17.
Unit tests miss the provider constraint because FunctionModel accepts tools-less requests over tool_use history, unlike real Bedrock and Anthropic endpoints.

The fix replaces hidden-tool filtering with synthetic steering results: WrapperToolset returns a steering notice instead of executing tools once run_step exceeds limit, keeping tool definitions advertised throughout the run.
